_comment: Create a device access in the Remote back office (Devices -> Add device). It gives you the server URL, the one-time token, and the device block. Add scripts/shell below as needed.
_discovery_comment: Your own networks: 'Scan for cameras' on the dashboard only works while this computer is on one of them (M7).
_cameras_comment: Local IP cameras to relay. Find them with: python3 agent/remote_agent.py --scan. Without a token they show in this device's camera picker; with their own device access (id + token) they show as separate devices. See the README for each brand's rtsp:// path.
